findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: email_suitability_decision, x402_payment_preflight_decision, domain_agent_discovery_check, domain_risk_trust_decision · Private data: evm_wallet_balance_lookup, evm_latest_block_lookup, token_security_decision, evm_gas_price_lookup, evm_transaction_hash_lookup · Public sink: email_suitability_decision, evm_transaction_execution_decision, defi_route_decision, domain_agent_discovery_check, domain_risk_trust_decision, evm_gas_price_lookup, evm_transaction_hash_lookup · Destructive: evm_transaction_execution_decision, x402_payment_preflight_decision, defi_route_decision, vendor_customer_adoption_change_lookup, evm_transaction_hash_lookup.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: email_suitability_decision, x402_payment_preflight_decision, domain_agent_discovery_check, domain_risk_trust_decision · Private data: evm_wallet_balance_lookup, evm_latest_block_lookup, token_security_decision, evm_gas_price_lookup, evm_transaction_hash_lookup · Public sink: email_suitability_decision, evm_transaction_execution_decision, defi_route_decision, domain_agent_discovery_check, domain_risk_trust_decision, evm_gas_price_lookup, evm_transaction_hash_lookup · Destructive: evm_transaction_execution_decision, x402_payment_preflight_decision, defi_route_decision, vendor_customer_adoption_change_lookup, evm_transaction_hash_lookup

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
